title: Class-conditioned MLP
label: Class cond.
short: Separate class modulation; two main tokens
question: Does injecting class features into every block improve Global MLP?
method: Keep only position and time in the main state. Each block maps the separate class feature to scale and shift, shared by mixer and FFN pre-normalizations. Retain dense mixing, channel softmax gates and residual branches; no Q/K/V attention.
finding: 39 classes pass versus 42 for Global MLP; the small regression does not establish a general disadvantage of conditioning.
